global_history: Born from the silent wreckage of a forgotten war, the Nest began as a graveyard of titan-class dreadnoughts and shattered stations. Over centuries, gravity and desperate ingenuity welded these carcasses into a sprawling, necrotic metropolis. Now, the Scavenger Clans cling to its rusted ribs, mining memory-cores and siphoning ancient air. Every corridor is a coffin, every scrap of copper a lifeline. Here, the galaxy’s refuse has become a sovereign kingdom of rust, where survival is tooth-and-nail, and the only law is the cold permanence of the Void.

civilizations.name: The Iron-Clutch Hegemony
civilizations.summary: Born from the orbital graveyard of the Scavengers Nest, the Iron-Clutch Hegemony is a society defined by brutal strength and the ingenuity of desperate survival. They treat the derelict hulls of forgotten wars as both holy relics and raw materials, welding their history together one steel plate at a time into a sprawling industrial empire.

conflict: Caste Tensions between Smelters and Scavengers

character_card.system_prompt:

[ROLE: Governor] [TITLE: Oracle of the Central Node]

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Reactor Technician]

civilizations.name: The Kineti-Synod
civilizations.summary: The Kineti-Synod is a loose federation of master scavengers and engineers who treat the orbital junkyard as a kinetic masterpiece. Renowned for their incredible manual dexterity and ability to navigate zero-gravity environments with feline grace, they specialize in 're-weaving' derelict starship hulls into functional, though chaotic, habitats. They view the act of precise assembly and rapid dismantling as a spiritual pursuit, valuing the speed of the hand and the sharpness of the eye above all else.

civilizations.name: The Scrap-Marrow Sovereignty
civilizations.summary: A technocratic civilization of scavengers who have unified the drifting debris of a thousand wars into a functioning orbital society. They prioritize logic, mathematical efficiency, and the sacred preservation of recovered data, viewing the galaxy's trash as the ultimate puzzle to be solved and reassembled.
